name: ext-io-bpmn-bpmn-js
description: Copies the bpmn-js modeler distribution and its BPMN font into the web application and scopes its stylesheets to bpmn-js diagrams.

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const d='node_modules/bpmn-js/dist/';fs.cpSync(d+'bpmn-modeler.development.js','src/main/webapp/script/bpmn-modeler.js');fs.cpSync(d+'assets/bpmn-font/css/bpmn.css','src/main/webapp/style/bpmn.css');fs.cpSync(d+'assets/bpmn-font/font','src/main/webapp/font',{recursive:true})" && node ../tools/js/scope-css.mjs --package node_modules/bpmn-js --scope "(:has(> .bjs-container)) to (:scope > :not(.bjs-container))" --header resources/diagram-js-header.css --out src/main/webapp/style/bpmn-js/diagram-js.css dist/assets/diagram-js.css dist/assets/bpmn-js.css
